The Alchemy principle

We will never issue a card. We will never stand between you and the merchant. We only *choose,* and your own card pays. So your four percent is still four percent, your warranty is still your warranty, and your statement reads exactly as if you had chosen the card *yourself.*

Rewards stay yoursYour issuer pays you directly, at the rate it promised.
Protections stay intactChargebacks, insurance and warranties work as your issuer intended.
Cards never leave your deviceWe store ciphertext. You hold the key.
No points of our ownNothing to devalue, nothing to freeze, nothing to expire.

Security architecture

We can't read your cards. By design.

Card numbers are sealed on your device with a key that never leaves it. We hold rules and ciphertext, nothing that could be spent.

On-device encryptionSealed on your device before anything is stored. Opened only there, at checkout.
Out of PCI scope by constructionNo card number is ever processed or stored in the clear on our infrastructure.
Canadian privacy law, from day oneBuilt to PIPEDA and Québec's Law 25. Data stays in Canada.
Nothing to freeze, nothing to drainNo balance, no credit, no Alchemy account to empty.
PIPEDALoi 25 · QuébecPCI DSS scope-minimizedOpen banking ready

Questions

Fair things to ask.

The short answers. The long ones are in our documentation and our privacy policy.

Is Alchemy another credit card?

No. Alchemy doesn't issue a card, hold your money, or sit in the payment. It chooses from the cards you already own and fills the winner at checkout. The merchant and your bank see a completely normal transaction.

How are my card details kept safe?

Card numbers are encrypted on your device before anything is stored, and decryption happens only on your device at the moment of checkout. Alchemy's servers hold ciphertext we cannot read. We build to PIPEDA and Québec's Law 25 from day one.

Do my bank's rewards and protections still work?

Yes. That is the design. Because your real card pays the merchant directly, category bonuses, purchase protection, extended warranty and chargeback rights behave exactly as your issuer defines them.

What if Alchemy picks wrong?

You see the runner-up and the gap before you pay, and you can override in one click. Every decision is logged in your monthly report with the rule that drove it, so you can check our work.

How does Alchemy make money?

The core product is free. We earn referral fees when you choose to apply for a better card we recommend, and through optional premium features. Never by selling personal data, never by minting points of our own.

En français?

Oui. Alchemy est bilingue, de l'interface aux contrats, parce qu'un portefeuille intelligent pour le Canada doit parler les deux langues. Use the EN / FR switch at the top of this page.
